Asha Patel: Day 3 check-in — what I did: set up MacBook, installed Docker & Homebrew, confirmed GitLab access. Cloned repo `redwood-inference/quickstart` and ran `make dev` to sanity-check the local server.

Asha Patel: Blockers: can't access k8s cluster (kubeconfig missing / 403 on `get-credentials`), GPU quota not enabled for my project, and SSH to bastion times out.

Asha Patel: Today: waiting on infra access; will read the serving runtime docs and prepare a tiny PR to improve the quickstart README with notes on local dev gotchas.

DevOps: Hey Asha — quick checklist: please run `gcloud auth login` then `gcloud container clusters get-credentials redwood-dev --zone=us-west1-b --project=redwood-infra`. If you see an auth/403 error paste the exact output here. I've created INF-4237 to add you to `gpu-users`. Also double-check your SSO invite (search email for 'Redwood SSO'). :email:

Asha Patel: Ran `get-credentials` and got `ERROR: (gcloud.container.clusters.get-credentials) ResponseError: 403 Forbidden: User not authorized.` Screenshot attached (omitted). Tried `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` — connection times out.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-4237 created and assigned to Samir. ETA: 2 business days. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INF-4237

Samir (IT): @Asha I resent the SSO invite and kicked the GPU group add. Can you confirm your employee ID (EID) so I can verify? As a debug step for the bastion, run:
```
ssh -vvv -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ubuntu@bastion.redwood
```
and paste the logs if it still times out.

Connor Wu: happy to help — I can do a quick screen-share at 3pm to walk through kube creds, project membership, and the bastion fallback. ping me when you're ready. :thumbsup:

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone — EID 2468. I'll rerun the commands and paste outputs here. I'll ping in the channel when I'm ready for the 3pm sync. Today's immediate plan: finish the serving runtime overview doc and open the README PR with a short "local dev gotchas" section.
